_metadata.title: Industry Reports 2026 — Verified Primary-Source Database
_metadata.purpose: Authoritative recruitment-marketing benchmark reports published between 2025-09-01 and 2026-05-22 for Joveo Nova chatbot knowledge base. Supplements existing recruitment_benchmarks_comprehensive_2026.json (Feb 2026 master) with reports released since.

verification_rules.primary_source_required: Every report verified at publisher domain. Secondary citations only used to corroborate, never as sole source.
verification_rules.paywall_handling: Numbers behind paywall labelled 'paywalled_unverified' — key findings from press releases/free summaries kept; full-report metrics noted as gated.
verification_rules.date_evidence: Every entry carries published_date confirmed at the publisher URL.
verification_rules.no_fabrication: Where a number could not be verified at the publisher, it is omitted or marked 'not_independently_verified'.

reliability_tiers.tier_1_government: BLS, ONS, Eurostat, OECD, ADP, ECB — government or quasi-government statistics
reliability_tiers.tier_2_platform_data: LinkedIn Workforce Reports, Indeed Hiring Lab, Appcast, Gem, Greenhouse, Employ, Bullhorn GRID — proprietary platform datasets with >1M observations
reliability_tiers.tier_3_industry_research: SHRM, Korn Ferry, Mercer, WTW, Aon, Hays, Robert Half, Universum, Aptitude Research, Recruitics, Glassdoor Economic Research — survey-based industry studies
reliability_tiers.tier_4_regional_specialty: Naukri JobSpeak, SEEK NZ/AU, StepStone DE, Reed UK, NSI Nursing Solutions, AHA — specialty/regional sources

_metadata.schema_notes: Each report carries: report_id, publisher, title, published_date, geography, sample_size, url_primary, url_press, key_metrics (each metric with value/unit/page_reference), tier, status (verified|paywalled_unverified|partial), retrieved_date

reports.title: 2026 Recruitment Marketing Benchmark Report (10th Annual, Global / US)

key_metrics.note: Tech reached 7.14% — white-collar recession distorted funnel

headline_findings: Even as the labour market cooled, recruiting got more expensive in 2025 — counter to economic theory.
